WHAT WE FIX FIRST

Where products
usually lose people.

An audit ranks every issue by impact and effort. These are the places it most often points to first.

Onboarding

Long sign-ups people quit, and first sessions that never reach the moment the product clicks.

Core flows

The everyday task people came for, buried under years of features and extra steps.

Activation

How fast a new user gets to the first win, and what stands in the way.

Empty and error states

A dashboard with no next step, or an error that doesn’t say what to do. Real users hit these daily.

Roles that share one flow

Admins, members or parents squeezed into a flow built for someone else, when each needs their own.

Design system drift

Five button styles and three ways to do the same thing slow your team down and confuse users.

BEFORE LAUNCH

What every page
is checked for before launch.

A good-looking page can still be slow, hard to use or invisible to search. We check these on every site we design and build.

Page speed

Sized images, video loaded only when in view, and a PageSpeed check before launch.

Accessibility

Contrast, focus states, labels and keyboard use, checked against WCAG 2.2.

SEO structure

Clean URLs, one H1 per page, and titles, descriptions and structured data that match it.

Redirects on a redesign

Every old URL kept, or sent to its closest new page with a real 301, so rankings come with you.

Phone and tablet layouts

Every section designed for smaller screens, not squeezed down from the desktop version.

Tracking that works

Demo bookings, signups and form events tracked, so you can see what the new site changes.

FINTECH DESIGN, IN SHORT

Updated October 2026

DesignMe is a fintech design agency. We design brands, websites and product UI for payments, banking, wealth and consumer finance companies, from stealth to Series B. Fintech clients include N3XT, Finverity, Duel, SuperAdvisor and Zave.it. We joined N3XT while it was in stealth and helped take it from idea to MVP in 3 months with a brand, product, website and investor story; N3XT has raised $72M across three rounds.

FINTECH CLIENTS
N3XT, Finverity, Duel, SuperAdvisor, Zave.it
FLAGSHIP RESULT
N3XT: idea to MVP in 3 months, $72M raised in stealth
CONSUMER FINTECH

FIT

A GOOD FIT IF

Funded payments, banking and wealth startups

Stealth fintechs that need brand and product

Teams whose product has outgrown its site

PROBABLY NOT A FIT IF
Not a fit:
Teams looking for legal or compliance sign-off: we design with your counsel, we do not replace them
Not a fit:
Banks that need a large in-house build team for core banking systems
Not a fit:
Projects that need a full brand, app and site in under four weeks

SOUND FAMILIAR?

You move money for people.
Your site has to look safe first.

Fintech teams tend to hit the same walls before visitors sign up. If a few of these sound like you, this page is for you.

Visitors leave before they understand what your product does.

It sits on payment rails, ledgers or regulation few people know. We turn the mechanics into a few clear steps, without dumbing it down for experts.

Your brand could be swapped with any other fintech’s.

Blue gradients, floating cards and the same three icons. We build a brand that feels as safe as a bank and looks like nobody else.

People drop out at KYC and document upload.

We design onboarding that explains why each step exists, saves progress and shows how long is left.

Finance teams and developers fight over the same page.

We give each a clean path. On N3XT that meant one route to sign-up and another straight to the docs.

Your disclosures were pasted into the footer at the last minute.

We plan licensing lines, risk warnings and partner bank wording from the first wireframe, so they read clearly and stay visible.

Visitors decide if you’re safe with their money before they read a word.

We put the trust signals they look for first where they look first, on the homepage and at every step that asks for money or data.
